}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== ===Specifications=== :'''Banana Pi BPI-M2 Magic''' Board *CPU: [[Allwinner]] A33 Quad-core @1.5GHz (ARM Cortex-A7) *GPU: Mali-400 MP2 OpenGL ES 2.0, H.265/HEVC *Memory: 512MB (DDR3) RAM (shared with GPU) *WiFi & BT: [[AMPAK]] AP6212, BT 4.0, SDIO *USB: 1x USB 2.0 host, 1x USB 2.0 (OTG) ports *GPIO: 40x pins header, compatible w/ Raspberry Pi B+ *Power: 5V/2A via barrel or USB OTG port
